option_relations.rationale: PARP inhibitor-induced interstitial lung disease is a specific type of drug-induced lung disease, which can lead to pulmonary fibrosis, making it a subtype of chemotherapy-induced pulmonary fibrosis.
Drug-induced interstitial lung disease (pneumonitis) is a broader category that includes chemotherapy-induced pulmonary fibrosis.
Drug-induced pneumonitis is a broader category that includes chemotherapy-induced pulmonary fibrosis.
Hypersensitivity pneumonitis is a distinct condition caused by an immune response to inhaled antigens, not directly related to chemotherapy-induced pulmonary fibrosis.
